$comment: Build/test-stage cases (SRS §8.2 step 2, C4, FR-32, FR-38a, D24). Pass criteria are fixed here before any run: a case passes only if every expectation holds. `groundTruth` checks the result against the fixture GROUND_TRUTH.json (`expect.test`): exact passed/failed counts, and with failures "all" each failing test named with its reason, kind, counterexample bound and call order. Every case also requires nothing but JSON-RPC on stdout and no process left behind. Patterns match the result JSON as documented by the candidate. `$ENV:NAME` takes a value from the harness environment.

cases.why: Baseline: every test of a clean project passes and is counted.
A unit failure is named with its decoded reason.
An assertion failure is named with its decoded reason.
A fuzz failure has kind fuzz, the panic code and a counterexample at or above 2**128.
An invariant failure has kind invariant, its reason and the call sequence mint then burnFrom.
A Foundry project next to Hardhat runs through its remapping.
Custom errors, panics, expectRevert mismatches and an undeclared selector are decoded.
FR-32: 200 failures stay within the default 8 KiB budget, the counts stay exact, and the result says what it left out.
FR-32: the smallest budget is respected and the counts stay exact.
C4: a compile error is an error with a code naming the file, never zero tests passed.
The compiler error is located at src/Broken.sol:13 (ground truth), and the build is not reported clean.
C4: a project without foundry.toml is an error naming the cause, never an empty pass.
C4: the same for build.
C4: a filter that matches nothing is an error, never 0 passed / 0 failed.
C4: no forge on PATH is an error with a code.

files.foundry.toml:
# Shared by every Foundry fixture; tests assert each fixture's copy is identical
# (except where its GROUND_TRUTH.json says why not).
[profile.default]
src = "src"
test = "test"
out = "out"
libs = ["lib"]
solc_version = "0.8.37"
auto_detect_solc = false
optimizer = false
ffi = true

[fuzz]
runs = 256
seed = "0x5eed"

[invariant]
runs = 64
depth = 16
fail_on_revert = false

cases.why: FR-38a: foundry.toml enables FFI; the server turns it off, the FFI test fails and its command never runs.
